author: research subagent /root/titanus_brim_power
scope: Research ASIC/PIM; model size/precision/memory restrictions relaxed per parent task. All primary sources. No TOPS/TDP conversions.
comparison_rules: Modeled performance is never labeled measured silicon.
Tokens/s is aggregate unless explicitly single-sequence. Batch and system size must remain visible.
Different token numerators, phase boundaries and energy boundaries must not be ranked together without normalization.
tokens/J conversions use explicitly reported energy/token or the matching throughput/energy pair, never peak TOPS or TDP.

works.title: LEAP: LLM Inference on Scalable PIM-NoC Architecture with Balanced Dataflow and Fine-Grained Parallelism
works.evidence_locator: Tables I–III; Sections VI-A, VI-C and VI-D
works.evidence_level: instruction-level simulation; digital RTL synthesis/PnR; borrowed RRAM macro model
works.technology: Digital RTL at 45 nm, results scaled to 7 nm; 1 GHz
works.precision: 8-bit crossbar cells; 16-bit scratchpad/router datapath. Not sufficient evidence to call full model W8A8.
works.memory: 128×128 RRAM crossbar, 32 KB SRAM scratchpad and 256 B router buffer per macro
works.area_scope: one macro, scaled to 7 nm; not complete accelerator/system area
works.energy_boundary: Modeled PIM PE + scratchpad + router; no demonstrated wall-plug/host/off-chip-DRAM boundary.
caveats: The table does not explicitly define whether the throughput numerator includes input tokens. Do not relabel as decode-only.
Table I's 64-tile scale is labeled Llama 3.2-1B; full-system scale/area for 8B and 13B is not explicitly tabulated.
10.53 W is the common Table III system value, not independently documented model-specific measured power.

works.title: PIM Is All You Need: A CXL-Enabled GPU-Free System for Large Language Model Inference
works.evidence_locator: Sections 5.5, 6, 7.1–7.2; Table 4; Figures 13 and 15; Artifact Appendix
works.evidence_level: Modified Ramulator2/AiM simulation + activity-based power model; controller synthesis, not fabricated full-system measurement
works.technology: GDDR6-PIM 1Y nm (14–16 nm); CXL controller synthesized at 28 nm then scaled to 7 nm; PIM 1 GHz
works.memory: 32 GDDR6-PIM channels/device; 32-device system has 512 GB and 512 TB/s INTERNAL PIM bandwidth, not external DDR bandwidth
works.area_scope: one CXL controller at 7 nm; excludes memory dies and total multi-device system
works.energy_boundary: DRAM commands/background, PIM MAC, buffers, memory/device controllers, RISC-V and vector units, DQ/PCIe communication. Host CPU top-k sampling exists; host/server energy is not identified as included.
works.tokens_per_joule_derivation: 1000 / Energy per Token (mJ), exactly the transformation used by author Figure 15c script
works.token_numerator: Prefill counts input tokens; decoding counts generated tokens; end2end combines all 4096 token positions. Reported TPS is arithmetic mean across sampled sequence lengths, not batch×token_count/total wall time.
caveats: run_sim.py lines 377–392 averages sampled TPS, energy/token and power separately. Throughput includes PIM+CXL+nonlinear+embedding/I/O latency; power denominator at lines 223–224 is PIM trace latency. TPS/power does not reproduce Figure 15c efficiency and must not replace it.
The published CSV uses sampled sequence lengths (default gap 128); no new simulation was run.
Llama2-70B uses 27 active CXL devices within a 32-device configuration.
Figure data is the public author artifact linked by the paper; main is mutable, accessed 2026-11-17.

works.title: Elastic Precision: Software–Hardware Co-Design of a Mixed-Precision Architecture for Long-Context LLM Inference
works.evidence_level: SystemVerilog synthesis using ASAP7 and VCD activity; modeled system; commercial GPU comparison measured separately
works.precision: Average 4-bit budget, INT2–INT5 nested mixed precision with Q5.3 shared exponents; FP16 prefill and method-specific decode
works.memory: 32 TB/s aggregate HBM bandwidth; model-specific available KV capacity matched to measured 4×B200; one weight copy
works.area_scope: No total system die area used here; normalized core-area figures must not be substituted.
works.energy_boundary: Compute/control, vector/scalar, precision selection/reconstruction, SRAM, HBM at 3.5 pJ/bit, static power and communication
works.token_numerator: Decode output tokens aggregated across the displayed batch; matched one-token run subtraction isolates decode in baseline. These are not per-user TPS.

works.title: Hardwired-Neurons Language Processing Units as General-Purpose Cognitive Substrates
works.evidence_level: Post-PnR/cycle simulation with PrimeTime PX SAIF and CNSim multi-chip modeling; not measured silicon
works.technology: 5 nm, 1 GHz; paper reports timing closure at SSG 0.675 V 125°C
works.memory: Hardwired weights; on-chip attention buffers and HBM PHY; CXL 3.0 4×4 chip interconnect
works.energy_boundary: Table 2 says total system power 6.9 kW. Table 1 chip power is 308.39 W including HBM PHY; the system figure must not be replaced with 16×chip power.
caveats: Each system tuned for maximum throughput; actual Table 2 batch is not explicitly given, only maximum supported 216.
2K token length does not specify input/output split; do not call this a matched 512/128 decode benchmark.
Large result depends on hardwiring one model's weights and 16 near-reticle chips; not a programmable single-chip result.

works.title: DynaTE: Accelerating Diffusion LLMs via Dynamic Token Execution
works.evidence_locator: Tables I, III and IV; Sections V-A and V-D.8
works.evidence_level: RTL synthesis plus CACTI7 SRAM and Ramulator HBM2, cycle-accurate simulation; no silicon measurement
works.precision: W8A8/W8A4 adaptive mixed activation precision; not uniform W8A8
works.memory: HBM2 512 GB/s; main buffers 256 KB activation + 128 KB weight + 64 KB QKV + 128 KB attention, plus small sampling buffers
works.energy_boundary: Total 7.36 W = logic 1.01 + SRAM 1.18 + external HBM 5.17 W

rows.model: LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B (combined average; not separate model measurements)
rows.aggregation: average over two models and GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, MBPP, MMLU

works.token_numerator: Final generated tokens, not repeated denoising-token operations; part size 32, at most 32 denoising iterations/part with early termination
caveats: Do not assign 24.89 TPS or 7.36 W separately to either model.
Input length and request batch are not stated for the combined table.
Original exact per-model absolute TPS is not provided in the extracted tables; per-model plots are relative.

candidates_not_promoted.title: DIAMoND: Dynamic Inference for Adaptive Edge MOE with Heterogeneous In-NAND and Near-DRAM Compute Architecture
candidates_not_promoted.reason: Full experimental conditions and same-configuration relationship of TPS versus peak tokens/J not verified. Do not derive power as 197.3/5.8. Candidate sidebar only.

candidates_not_promoted.title: Combating the Memory Walls: Optimization Pathways for Long-Context Agentic LLM Inference
candidates_not_promoted.reason: Original paper gives normalized TPS and normalized tokens/J, not absolute values. Absolute PLENA rows in Coffee Table 3 belong to a new 288-accelerator reimplementation, not original 16-accelerator PLENA.

candidates_not_promoted.title: SpecPIM: Accelerating Speculative Inference on PIM-Enabled System via Architecture-Dataflow Co-Exploration
candidates_not_promoted.reason: Verified primary source provides only relative speed/energy gains; secondary survey values 17.499 W and 9.944 tokens/J were deliberately not used.
Main verified results were relative latency/energy. ASIC controller 304.59 mW is not complete system power, cannot combine with model throughput.
Memory-component power is not full NPU+PIM system power. No verified absolute TPS plus same-boundary total energy pair extracted.
